name: @w6w-apps/shortcut
description: Manage Shortcut stories, epics, iterations, workflows and labels — the project-management tool formerly known as Clubhouse.

w6w.longDescription:
Shortcut (formerly Clubhouse) is a project-management tool built around Stories — the atomic unit of work — grouped into Epics, scheduled into time-boxed Iterations, and moved through a team's own Workflow states. This app covers that core model end to end: create, read, update, delete and search Stories; manage Epics and their comments; create and update Iterations; read Workflows and their states; and manage Labels, Projects and the comment threads on Stories and Epics.

Every Story, Epic, Iteration, Label and Project id in Shortcut's API is a plain integer, not a UUID — the one exception being Members, which are addressed by UUID. Getting that mixed up is the most common way a request against this API 404s.

Health checks track Shortcut's own status page. Shortcut publishes no readable request-rate headroom (only a fixed 200-requests-per-minute ceiling enforced by a 429), so that dimension is declared unavailable rather than guessed at.
